assumptions: Negation cue list limited to no / not / without / avoid / never / don't / dont - the forms the issue names plus the apostrophe variant; no general negation parsing.
The cue must fall within the 3 words immediately before the match, so 'never use a snapshot test' is caught without reaching back into an unrelated clause.
A cue is confined to its own clause: the lookback is cut at . ! ? ; or newline, so 'No. We decided to add a snapshot test' still classifies as visual.

The guard applies to every keyword table matched via matchesAny (PERFORMANCE_KEYWORDS, CATEGORY_KEYWORDS, TRAILING_RULES), not only the visual entry, since all three share the substring-matching failure mode.
Scope kept to the classifier: the catalog-wide prompt-vs-documented-tag test the issue contemplates is a separate, larger claim and was not added here.
